unit.label: Tuition, future work & past-event focus
unit.title: Who Paid the Tuition?
unit.description: Finish this lesson the conversation with tuition, company support, future work plans, studying while working, encouragement, and the 是…的 focus construction for past events.

banner.text: 我的學費是公司替我付的
banner.pinyin: Wǒ de xuéfèi shì gōngsī tì wǒ fù de

goal.text: 我的學費是公司替我付的。
goal.pinyin: Wǒ de xuéfèi shì gōngsī tì wǒ fù de.
goal.meaning: My tuition is paid by my company for me.

unit.bookReference: A Course in Contemporary Chinese 1 · Lesson 12 「你在臺灣學多久的中文？」 Dialogue I tail / Vocabulary I (printed pp. 246–249) and Grammar II 是…的 (printed pp. 253–255). This unit completes Dialogue I, teaches the source past-event focus construction, and introduces standalone 以後 'in the future' from Dialogue I. Dialogue II, Vocabulary II, Grammar III Event + 以後, and Grammar IV 好/難 + verbs remain deferred.

lessons.title: Who Paid the Tuition?
lessons.subtitle: Learn 學費, 公司, and 替 through the sentence that introduces 是…的.

steps.prompt: What does 學費 mean?
steps.explanation: 學費 is the word for tuition.

steps.prompt: In 我的學費是公司替我付的, what is focused by 是…的?
steps.explanation: 學費 is fronted as the topic/object; 公司 is the focused subject that paid it.

lessons.title: What Part of the Past Matters?
lessons.subtitle: Practice subject, time, place, and manner focus, then cover yes/no questions, optional 是, and the wh-question types.

steps.prompt: In 他是昨天晚上到臺灣的, what is the focus?
steps.explanation: 是 comes directly before 昨天晚上, so the time is highlighted.

steps.prompt: Which sentence focuses how the speaker came to class?
options: 我是在學校附近吃晚飯的。
他是昨天晚上到臺灣的。
steps.explanation: 坐公車 is the manner phrase immediately after 是.

steps.prompt: Which element cannot be the focus in 是…的?
steps.explanation: The pattern allows subject, time, place, manner, and occasionally the verb as focus, but not the object.

steps.prompt: Which yes/no question correctly uses 是…的?
options: 你的房租是自己付的嗎？
你的房租是自己嗎付的？
steps.answer: 你的房租是自己付的嗎？
steps.explanation: The rule here shows yes/no questions by keeping the 是…的 frame and adding 嗎.

steps.prompt: What is true about 是 in this construction?
steps.explanation: The the rule explicitly gives examples such as 我跟朋友一起來的 with 是 omitted.

steps.prompt: Which list contains only wh-question types allowed with past-event 是…的?
steps.explanation: The rule here allows who, when, how, and where, but not 'what' when it is the object.

lessons.title: The Company Decides
lessons.subtitle: Finish the duration exchange and retrieve 大概, 決定, 打算, and 是…的.

steps.prompt: What does 大概兩年 mean here?
steps.explanation: 大概 marks an approximate or probable amount.

steps.prompt: In 是公司決定的, which information is highlighted?
steps.explanation: 是 directly precedes 公司, so the company is the focused element.

lessons.title: A Good Company in the Future
lessons.subtitle: Learn 希望, standalone 以後, and 上班 through the next sentence.

steps.prompt: What does 希望 mean?
steps.explanation: 希望 is the lesson verb 'to hope.'

steps.prompt: What does 以後 mean in this sentence?
steps.explanation: Here 以後 stands alone as a future time expression. Event + 以後 'after…' comes later in this lesson.

steps.prompt: What does 上班 mean?
steps.explanation: 上班 is the lesson separable verb 'to go to work.'

lessons.title: Work and Study
lessons.subtitle: Learn 念書 and 累 while retrieving the earlier 又…又… pattern.

steps.prompt: What does 念書 mean here?
steps.explanation: 念書 is a separable verb meaning 'to study.'

steps.prompt: Which earlier pattern is reused in 我又要上班，又要念書?
steps.explanation: 又…又… links the two parallel obligations: work and study.

steps.prompt: How does the speaker feel after working and studying?
steps.explanation: 累 means tired; 真的很累 intensifies the reaction.

lessons.title: Keep It Up
lessons.subtitle: Finish the conversation with 加油 and complete the key negation/question restrictions of 是…的.

steps.prompt: What does 加油 mean in 我們一起加油吧?
steps.explanation: In this phrase, 加油 is encouragement, not a literal instruction about oil.

steps.prompt: Which negation follows the rule here 是…的 rule?
options: 我不是在圖書館看書的。
我是不在圖書館看書的。
steps.answer: 我不是在圖書館看書的。
steps.explanation: 不 goes before 是: 不是…的.

steps.prompt: Which past-event question correctly asks when he came to school?
options: 他是什麼時候來學校的？
他是什麼東西來學校的？
steps.answer: 他是什麼時候來學校的？
steps.explanation: 是…的 can ask who, when, how, or where about a past event; the rule here excludes 'what' when it is the object.

steps.prompt: Can 是 sometimes be omitted in this construction?
options: yes, 是 can sometimes be omitted
steps.answer: yes, 是 can sometimes be omitted
steps.explanation: The rule here explicitly notes that 是 can sometimes be omitted, as in 我跟朋友一起來的.

lessons.title: Unit 35 Review
lessons.subtitle: Tuition, company support, future work, work-and-study pressure, encouragement, and past-event focus.

steps.prompt: Which word means tuition?
steps.explanation: 學費 means tuition.

steps.prompt: Which word means 'for / on behalf of'?
steps.explanation: 替 introduces the person on whose behalf an action is done.

steps.prompt: Which word means 'to hope'?
steps.explanation: 希望 means to hope.

steps.prompt: Which expression means 'in the future' in this conversation?
steps.explanation: the conversation uses standalone 以後 for 'in the future.'

steps.prompt: Which word means tired?
steps.explanation: 累 means tired.

steps.prompt: Which phrase is used to encourage someone?
steps.explanation: 加油 means 'keep it up / keep up the good work.'

steps.prompt: Which sentence focuses the time of a past event?
options: 他是昨天晚上到臺灣的。
他是在學校附近吃晚飯的。
steps.answer: 他是昨天晚上到臺灣的。
steps.explanation: 昨天晚上 follows 是, so time is the focus.

steps.prompt: Which sentence focuses place?
options: 他是在學校附近吃晚飯的。
steps.answer: 他是在學校附近吃晚飯的。
steps.explanation: 在學校附近 is the focused place phrase.

steps.prompt: Which element cannot be focused by 是…的?
steps.explanation: The object may be moved to the front as topic, but it is not the focused element.

steps.prompt: Which negative form is correct?
steps.explanation: 不 must come before 是.

steps.prompt: Which is a valid 是…的 past-event wh-question?
steps.explanation: The construction can ask how; the rule here rejects using it to ask 'what' as the object.

newVocabulary.note: the conversation uses 以後 by itself as a future time expression. Event + 以後 'after…' is taught later in this lesson and is deliberately deferred.

費.note: 費 is fourth-tone fèi. In this lesson, learn it inside 學費, 'tuition.'
費.memory: Write the five-stroke 弗 upper part first, then place the seven-stroke 貝 below it.

parts.label: 弗
parts.name: upper component
parts.description: The first five strokes form 弗 at the top.

parts.label: 貝
parts.name: shell component
parts.description: The final seven strokes form 貝 at the bottom.

司.note: 司 is first-tone sī. Here it is learned as the second character of 公司, 'company.'
司.memory: Keep the outer turning stroke compact around the inner 一 and 口 structure.

parts.label: 司
parts.name: whole character
parts.description: All five strokes form the compact 司 character.

替.note: 替 is fourth-tone tì and is a preposition meaning 'for; on behalf of.' Put 替 + person before the action: 公司替我付 = 'the company pays for me.'
替.memory: Write 㚘—two 夫 shapes side by side—across the top, then finish with the four-stroke 曰 at the bottom.

parts.label: 㚘
parts.name: paired 夫 component
parts.description: The first eight strokes form 㚘, visually two 夫 shapes side by side.

parts.label: 曰
parts.name: 曰 component
parts.description: The final four strokes form the wide 曰 component at the bottom.

example.meaning: pay for me; pay on my behalf

希.note: 希 is first-tone xī. Learn it together with 望 in 希望, 'to hope.'
希.memory: Start with the crossed top strokes, then build the 布-like lower structure underneath.

parts.label: 乂
parts.name: crossed top
parts.description: The first two strokes form the crossed top.

parts.label: 布
parts.name: lower structure
parts.description: The final five strokes form the lower 布-like structure.

望.note: 望 is fourth-tone wàng. In this lesson it completes 希望, 'to hope.'
望.memory: Set 亡 and 月 across the upper area, then anchor the character with 王 at the bottom.

parts.label: 亡
parts.name: upper-left component
parts.description: The first three strokes form 亡.

parts.label: 月
parts.name: moon component
parts.description: The next four strokes form 月.

parts.label: 王
parts.name: king component
parts.description: The final four strokes form 王.

班.note: 班 is first-tone bān. Here it appears in 上班, 'to go to work.' In Taiwan's standard form, the center is written as two narrow strokes between the two 王 sides; do not confuse 班 with 斑.
班.memory: Balance 王 on the left and 王 on the right; the two narrow middle strokes, 丶 then 丿, are the modern form of the knife-derived center.

parts.label: 王
parts.name: left jade component
parts.description: The first four strokes form 王 on the left.

parts.label: 丶丿
parts.name: knife-derived middle strokes
parts.description: The next two strokes are a dot and a left-falling stroke in the narrow center.

parts.label: 王
parts.name: right jade component
parts.description: The final four strokes form 王 on the right.

累.note: 累 is fourth-tone lèi. The this lesson line 真的很累 describes being exhausted from working and studying.
累.memory: Write 田 first, then place the six-stroke 糸 thread component underneath.

parts.label: 田
parts.name: field component
parts.description: The first five strokes form 田.

parts.label: 糸
parts.name: thread component
parts.description: The final six strokes form 糸.

加.meaning: add; first character of 加油
加.note: 加 is first-tone jiā. In 加油, the whole expression is encouragement: 'keep it up / keep up the good work.'
加.memory: Write 力 on the left, then add the three-stroke 口 on the right.

parts.label: 力
parts.name: strength component
parts.description: The first two strokes form 力.

parts.label: 口
parts.name: mouth component
parts.description: The final three strokes form 口.

油.meaning: oil; second character of 加油
油.note: 油 is second-tone yóu. In 加油, do not translate the two characters literally; the phrase is used to encourage someone.
油.memory: Keep 氵 narrow on the left and write the five-stroke 由 clearly on the right.

parts.label: 氵
parts.name: water component
parts.description: The first three strokes form 氵.

parts.label: 由
parts.name: right component
parts.description: The final five strokes form 由.

u35-shi-de.title: Focus a past event with 是…的
u35-shi-de.pattern: Subject / Topic + 是 + Focus + Activity + 的
u35-shi-de.explanation: 是…的 highlights one element of a past event as the focus or contrast. Put 是 directly before the focused element and 的 at the end. The focused element can be the subject, time, place, manner, and occasionally the verb, but never the object. An object is often moved to the very front as the topic, as in 學費是公司替我付的. Put 不 before 是 for negation. The rule here also forms yes/no questions with 嗎, notes that 是 can sometimes be omitted, and allows wh-questions asking who, when, how, or where about a past event; it specifically excludes using the construction to ask 'what' when 'what' is the object.

examples.pinyin: Xuéfèi shì gōngsī tì wǒ fù de.
examples.meaning: My tuition is paid by my company for me.

examples.text: 他是昨天晚上到臺灣的。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì zuótiān wǎnshang dào Táiwān de.
examples.meaning: It was last night that he arrived in Taiwan.

examples.text: 他是在學校附近吃晚飯的。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì zài xuéxiào fùjìn chī wǎnfàn de.
examples.meaning: It was near the school that he ate dinner.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì zuò gōngchē lái shàngkè de.
examples.meaning: I came to class by bus.

examples.text: 我不是在圖書館看書的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú shì zài túshūguǎn kàn shū de.
examples.meaning: It wasn't at the library that I read.

u35-shi-de.remember: Past event: put 是 before the focused information and 的 at the end. Object focus is not allowed. Negation is 不是…的; yes/no questions can add 嗎; 是 can sometimes be omitted; wh-questions can ask who, when, how, or where.

u35-tuition.text: 我的學費是公司替我付的。
u35-tuition.pinyin: Wǒ de xuéfèi shì gōngsī tì wǒ fù de.
u35-tuition.meaning: My tuition is paid by my company for me.
u35-tuition.note: This conversation This answers the preceding 你呢？ from the scholarship turn. 學費 is fronted as the topic/object, and 公司 is the focused subject inside 是…的.

u35-duration-question.pinyin: Nǐ dǎsuàn xué duō jiǔ ne?
u35-duration-question.meaning: And how long do you plan to study?
u35-duration-question.note: This retrieves 打算 and 多久 from earlier units.

u35-decision.text: 大概兩年，是公司決定的。
u35-decision.pinyin: Dàgài liǎng nián, shì gōngsī juédìng de.
u35-decision.meaning: Probably two years. My company will decide.
u35-decision.note: This conversation 是…的 focuses 公司 as the decider.

u35-future.text: 希望我以後也可以到這麼好的公司上班。
u35-future.pinyin: Xīwàng wǒ yǐhòu yě kěyǐ dào zhème hǎo de gōngsī shàngbān.
u35-future.meaning: I hope that in the future I can work at such a good company too.
u35-future.note: Here 以後 stands alone as a future time expression. this lesson later teaches Event + 以後 'after…'; that grammar is deliberately deferred.

u35-workstudy.text: 我又要上班，又要念書，真的很累。
u35-workstudy.pinyin: Wǒ yòu yào shàngbān, yòu yào niànshū, zhēnde hěn lèi.
u35-workstudy.meaning: I have to both work and study. It is exhausting.
u35-workstudy.note: This retrieves the earlier 又…又… pattern while adding 上班, 念書, and 累.

u35-cheer.meaning: Let's keep up the good work!
u35-cheer.note: 加油 is the source encouragement phrase at the end of the conversation.

u35-focus-time.text: 他是昨天晚上到臺灣的。
u35-focus-time.pinyin: Tā shì zuótiān wǎnshang dào Táiwān de.
u35-focus-time.meaning: It was last night that he arrived in Taiwan.
u35-focus-time.note: 是 directly precedes the focused time expression.

u35-focus-place.text: 他是在學校附近吃晚飯的。
u35-focus-place.pinyin: Tā shì zài xuéxiào fùjìn chī wǎnfàn de.
u35-focus-place.meaning: It was near the school that he ate dinner.
u35-focus-place.note: 是 directly precedes the focused place expression 在學校附近.

u35-focus-manner.pinyin: Wǒ shì zuò gōngchē lái shàngkè de.
u35-focus-manner.meaning: I came to class by bus.
u35-focus-manner.note: 是 directly precedes the focused manner phrase 坐公車.

u35-focus-negative.text: 我不是在圖書館看書的。
u35-focus-negative.pinyin: Wǒ bú shì zài túshūguǎn kàn shū de.
u35-focus-negative.meaning: It wasn't at the library that I read.
u35-focus-negative.note: The rule here places 不 before 是: 不是…的.

u35-focus-when.text: 他是什麼時候來學校的？
u35-focus-when.pinyin: Tā shì shénme shíhou lái xuéxiào de?
u35-focus-when.meaning: When was it that he came to school?
u35-focus-when.note: A past-event wh-question can ask for time inside 是…的.

u35-focus-subject.pinyin: Shì wǒ dǎ diànhuà gěi fángdōng de.
u35-focus-subject.meaning: It was I who called the landlord.
u35-focus-subject.note: The uses this to show subject focus: 是 comes immediately before 我.

u35-focus-yesno.text: 你的房租是自己付的嗎？
u35-focus-yesno.pinyin: Nǐ de fángzū shì zìjǐ fù de ma?
u35-focus-yesno.meaning: Do you pay your own rent?
u35-focus-yesno.note: The rule here forms a yes/no question by adding 嗎 to the 是…的 sentence.

u35-focus-omitted.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ lái de.
u35-focus-omitted.note: The rule here notes that 是 can sometimes be omitted; this is the example with 是 left out.

u35-focus-who.pinyin: Shì shéi dǎ diànhuà gěi nǐ de?
u35-focus-who.meaning: Who was it that called you?
u35-focus-who.note: A past-event 是…的 wh-question can ask who.

u35-focus-how.note: A past-event 是…的 wh-question can ask how.

u35-focus-where.pinyin: Nǐ shì zài nǎlǐ chīfàn de?
u35-focus-where.note: A past-event 是…的 wh-question can ask where.
